en.meta_description: JJchess is a vibe coder exploring interfaces, interaction and the space between an idea and something you can play with.
en.hero_copy: I'm JJchess. A vibe coder turning curiosity into interfaces that feel good to use.
en.hero_caption: A SMALL INTERFACE. A LITTLE ROOM TO PLAY.
en.intro_heading: From a conversation to something you can touch.
en.intro_copy: I build in Codex and Claude Code, then keep refining the details: the weight of a button, the rhythm of a page, the way an interaction responds. This is where those explorations live.
en.selected_copy: Components, pages and experiments. Made to be used, explored and taken apart.
en.empty_copy: No projects have been published here yet. While the collection takes shape, try the interactive playground on the homepage.
en.story_heading: The details make it feel alive.
en.story_copy: A structure becomes an interface. An interface becomes an experience. Scroll to see the pieces come together.
en.story_end: Now make it your own. Every control is live.
en.contact_kicker: ANOTHER IDEA IS ALWAYS AROUND THE CORNER
en.footer_note: A personal playground, always in progress.
en.projects_copy: An evolving collection of interfaces and interactions. Each one comes with its thinking, its details and its source.
en.filter_empty: Nothing in this category yet. Try another filter.

en.original_language_en: Some project notes are currently available in English.
en.about_intro: I'm JJchess, a deep vibe coder. I work through conversations with Codex and Claude Code, following an idea all the way into a working interface.
en.about_copy: I care about the little things that make a digital experience feel considered. A clear hierarchy. An unexpected response. Motion that helps you understand what's happening.
en.practice_one_copy: Start with a question, a detail or a feeling worth exploring. Turn it into something small enough to try.
en.practice_two_copy: Use conversation to build a working version. Put it in a browser and interact with it.
en.practice_three_copy: Test the edges, tune the response and keep the source. A good idea gets better through use.
en.direction_one_copy: The smallest parts, with the right amount of feedback.
en.direction_two_copy: Type, space and movement working together.
en.direction_three_copy: A place for the ideas that don't fit a familiar shape.

zh.page_home_title: 把想法，做成可以玩的界面
zh.meta_description: JJchess 的个人交互实验室。在 Codex 与 Claude Code 中，将好奇心做成可操作的界面、页面和交互实验。
zh.hero_kicker: 关于界面与交互的独立探索
zh.hero_copy: 我是 JJchess，一个深度 vibe coder。把好奇心，变成用起来让人会心一笑的界面。
zh.hero_caption: 一个小界面，一点可以自由发挥的空间。
zh.intro_heading: 从一段对话，到一个可以触摸的想法。
zh.intro_copy: 我在 Codex 和 Claude Code 中构建界面，再不断推敲细节：按钮的反馈、页面的节奏、交互的回应。这里记录这些探索。
zh.selected_copy: 组件、页面与交互实验。可以使用，可以探索，也可以拆开看看。
zh.empty_copy: 这里还没有正式发布的作品。等待第一件作品的时候，可以先玩一玩首页的交互装置。
zh.story_copy: 结构成为界面，界面成为体验。继续向下，看看这些部件如何组合起来。
zh.story_end: 现在，交给你。每个控件都可以操作。
zh.contact_kicker: 下一个想法，随时都可能出现
zh.footer_note: 个人交互实验室，持续探索中。
zh.projects_copy: 关于界面与交互的持续记录。每件作品，都留下思考、细节与源码。

zh.about_intro: 我是 JJchess，一个深度 vibe coder。我与 Codex、Claude Code 对话，把一个想法逐步做成可以使用的界面。
zh.about_copy: 我在意那些让数字体验更耐看的细节：清楚的信息层级、意料之外的反馈，以及能帮助理解的动态变化。
zh.practice_one_copy: 从一个问题、一个细节或一种感受开始，把它变成可以动手验证的小想法。
zh.practice_two_copy: 通过对话做出能运行的版本，放进浏览器，亲自操作。
zh.practice_three_copy: 检查边界，调整反馈，保留源码。让好的想法在使用中继续变好。
zh.directions_heading: 从微小细节，到完整体验。
zh.direction_one_copy: 把恰到好处的反馈，放进最小的部件里。
zh.direction_two_copy: 让文字、空间与动态一起工作。
zh.direction_three_copy: 为那些不落入常见形式的想法，留一个位置。
